sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "diaries" ("rid" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, "id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "category_id" TEXT, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "time" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_modified" INTEGER NOT NULL, "show" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mood" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "aspect" REAL, "place_id" TEXT, "weather_icon" TEXT, "weather_temp" TEXT, "weather_text" TEXT);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "diary_links" ("src_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES diaries(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "dst_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(src_id, dst_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "diary_chunks" ("rid" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, "diary_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_off" INTEGER NOT NULL, "len" INTEGER NOT NULL, "text_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(diary_id, seq));
CREATE INDEX idx_diary_chunks_diary ON diary_chunks (diary_id)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "embed_queue" ("diary_id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "enqueued_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "llm_providers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_url" TEXT NOT NULL, "default_model" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "preset_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "models_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "tool_call" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "reasoning" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "attachment" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);
CREATE INDEX idx_llm_providers_sort ON llm_providers (sort_order)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "chat_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "title" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "provider_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "model" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reasoning_effort" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "compacted_summary" TEXT, "compacted_up_to_message_id" TEXT, "compacted_at" INTEGER, "compacted_input_tokens_at_trigger" INTEGER);
CREATE INDEX idx_chat_sessions_updated ON chat_sessions (updated_at DESC)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "chat_messages" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chat_sessions(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reasoning" TEXT, "thinking_millis" INTEGER, "image_name" TEXT, "input_tokens" INTEGER, "output_tokens" INTEGER, "model" TEXT, "provider_id" TEXT);
CREATE INDEX idx_chat_messages_session ON chat_messages (session_id, created_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "assistant_tool_calls" ("message_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chat_messages(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "call_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "args_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "result" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "done" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY(message_id, seq));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "memories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source" TEXT);
CREATE INDEX idx_memories_updated ON memories (updated_at DESC)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tombstones" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "time_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "pushed_backends_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]');
CREATE INDEX idx_tombstones_time ON tombstones (time_ms)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_modified" INTEGER NOT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT, "color" INTEGER);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fonts" ("font_family" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "font_file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "wght_axis_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}');
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "media_infos" ("file_name" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" TEXT, "duration_ms" INTEGER, "last_modified" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "places" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "latitude" REAL NOT NULL, "longitude" REAL NOT NULL, "icon" TEXT, "last_modified" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX idx_diaries_show_time ON diaries (show, time DESC, id DESC)
CREATE INDEX idx_diaries_show_cat_time ON diaries (show, category_id, time DESC, id DESC)
CREATE INDEX idx_diaries_show_lastmod ON diaries (show, last_modified DESC, id DESC)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "diary_media" ("diary_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES diaries(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(diary_id, kind, seq));
CREATE INDEX idx_diary_media_kind ON diary_media (kind, diary_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_diary_media_file ON diary_media (file_name)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "diary_tags" ("diary_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES diaries(id)ON DELETE CASCADE, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tag" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(diary_id, seq));
CREATE INDEX idx_diary_tags_tag ON diary_tags (tag)
CREATE INDEX idx_diary_links_dst ON diary_links (dst_id)
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "diary_fts" USING fts5(title, content_text, content='diaries', content_rowid='rid', tokenize='simple');
CREATE TRIGGER diary_fts_ai AFTER INSERT ON diaries BEGIN INSERT INTO diary_fts ("rowid", title, content_text) VALUES (new.rid, new.title, new.content_text);END
CREATE TRIGGER diary_fts_ad AFTER DELETE ON diaries BEGIN INSERT INTO diary_fts (diary_fts, "rowid", title, content_text) VALUES ('delete', old.rid, old.title, old.content_text);END

CREATE TRIGGER diary_fts_au AFTER UPDATE OF title, content_text ON diaries WHEN old.title IS NOT new.title OR old.content_text IS NOT new.content_text BEGIN INSERT INTO diary_fts (diary_fts, "rowid", title, content_text) VALUES ('delete', old.rid, old.title, old.content_text);INSERT INTO diary_fts ("rowid", title, content_text) VALUES (new.rid, new.title, new.content_text);END
